**In one line**: Anthropic, the maker of Claude, reportedly saw its second-quarter revenue surpass $11.5 billion.

### Key points
- According to CNBC, Anthropic's Q2 revenue reportedly reached more than $11.5 billion.
- Rising demand for enterprise API access and subscriptions built on the Claude models is said to have driven the growth.
- The figure lands amid an intensifying frontier-model race with OpenAI, underscoring efforts to prove commercial traction.

### Why it matters
The report is a signal that generative-AI companies are converting hype into large-scale, realized revenue. With the sustainability of the industry hinging on whether massive training and inference costs can be recouped, the revenue of a leading developer serves as a bellwether for the broader market.
